name: @activepieces/piece-mem
description: Capture and organize your thoughts using Mem.ai

auth.description: You can obtain your API key by navigating to **Integrations→ API**.

create_mem.name: create_mem
create_mem.description: Save any content to Mem.ai for intelligent processing and future reference.

input.description: Raw content you want to remember - HTML, emails, transcripts, or simple notes.

instructions.description: Optional guidance on how you want this content processed or remembered.

context.description: Additional background information to relate this to your existing knowledge.

aiMetadata.description: Sends raw content (HTML, emails, transcripts, or plain notes) to Mem.ai's "mem-it" endpoint, where it is intelligently processed and filed into the knowledge base; optionally accepts processing instructions and background context. Use to capture unstructured material and let Mem decide how to organize it, rather than writing a specific note. Not idempotent: each call ingests the content anew.

create_note.name: create_note
create_note.description: Log a plain-text Markdown note into Mem, optionally with formatting, templates, collections, and timestamps.

content.description: Markdown-formatted content. First line is treated as the note title.

id.description: Optional UUID to assign to the note.

add_to_collections.description: Collection titles or IDs to assign this note to. New collections will be created if they don’t exist.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a Markdown note in Mem, using the first line as the title, and can assign it to one or more collections (creating them if they do not exist). Use when you want to store a specific, ready-formatted note rather than hand raw content to Mem's processor. Not idempotent: a new note is created on each call, even when a Note ID is supplied.

delete_note.name: delete_note
delete_note.description: Delete a note in Mem by its ID.

note_id.description: The ID of the note to delete.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes a single note in Mem identified by its note ID. Use to remove a note you can address by ID. Destructive and not idempotent: the first call removes the note and a repeat with the same ID will fail because the note no longer exists.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description: You can obtain your API key by navigating to **Integrations→ API**.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description: You can obtain your API key by navigating to **Integrations→ API**.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
